messages.subject: How to report model selection with WAIC
parts:
Hi everyone,

Maybe this is not the proper forum to post this question, but I have looked for other forums and references and can't seem to figure out the proper way to report model selection using WAIC, for a paper.

I built multi-scale occupancy models in JAGS, and used WAIC for model selection, following this approach:
https://sourceforge.net/p/mcmc-jags/discussion/610036/thread/8211df61/#ea5c 

So I get a value for WAIC and deviance, where they state that ""deviance" is the deviance statistic for each observed node and "WAIC" is the corresponding WAIC penalty".

I also found this similar approach, but here the parameters are a bit different (waic and p_waic):
https://gist.github.com/oliviergimenez/68ad17910a62635ff6a062f8ec34292f

Are there any guidelines on how to report model selection with WAIC? Which of these parameters should I use?

Thank you so much for any advice.
Cheers,
Ana
